## Release

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Crusader_Kings_III&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Release")]

The game was released on 1 September 2020 and is available through [Steam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steam_(service) "Steam (service)") and [Xbox Game Pass for PC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xbox_Game_Pass_for_PC "Xbox Game Pass for PC").[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-:0-12)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-32) The game is available in two editions: the Base Game Edition, which includes the base game and a pre-order bonus, and the Royal Edition, which includes the base game and an expansion pass. The expansion pass contains a collection of additional content packs and the first expansion.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-33)

_Crusader Kings III_ was initially rejected by the [Australian Classification Board](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_Classification_Board "Australian Classification Board"), reportedly over complications regarding the game's classification. However, the [Australian Classification Board](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_Classification_Board "Australian Classification Board") denied having contact with [Paradox Interactive](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paradox_Interactive "Paradox Interactive"), who claimed they sought classification through the third party distributor [Plaion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plaion "Plaion"), formerly Koch Media.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-34) The game was eventually cleared and released in Australia six days after its initial release, on 7 September 2020. Because of its delayed release, the pre-order bonus window was extended to 21 September exclusively for Australian Steam users.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-35)[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-36)

A console version of the game was released on [PlayStation 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PlayStation_5 "PlayStation 5") and [Xbox Series X and Series S](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xbox_Series_X_and_Series_S "Xbox Series X and Series S") on 29 March 2022.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-37)[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-38) The game was made available on Xbox Game Pass on the same day.[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-39)

_Crusader Kings III_ received "generally favorable" reviews for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S according to [review aggregator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Review_aggregator "Review aggregator") platform [Metacritic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metacritic "Metacritic");[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-MCPS5-41)[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-MCXSXS-42) the PC version received "universal acclaim".[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-MCPC-40) Leana Hafer of _[IGN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IGN "IGN")_ wrote that the game "is a superb strategy game, a great [RPG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Role-playing_game "Role-playing game"), and a master class in how to take the best parts of existing systems and make them deeper and better"; scoring it 10/10 in her review.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-IGNreview-45) Lauren Aitken from _[VG247](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VG247 "VG247")_ also gave the game a perfect score, writing it is "just as bonkers, unpredictable and enthralling as its predecessor."[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-VG247-51)

David Wildgoose of _[GameSpot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GameSpot "GameSpot")_ praised the procedural narratives of the game saying that they are rarely as affecting and poignant as they are here; on the other hand, as a negative point, he wrote that "when the story engine isn't firing, your actions can feel rote and uninspired".[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-GameSpotreview-44)

The console port of the game has been criticized by players due to being "unplayable" during the late-game due to technological bottlenecks, frequent crashes, overheating, and other limitations to console capabilities. Paradox and Lab42 have been working to fix these issues by removing the 3D models in family trees and more frequent clearing of the game's cache.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-52) Because of Lab42 struggling to develop the console version of the game, they were later replaced by [Dragon lake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Room_8_Group "Room 8 Group").[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-53)

### Sales

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Crusader_Kings_III&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Sales")]

The game sold more than 1 million copies within 1 month of release.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-54) It was the seventh best-selling game in September 2020 in the US, and had the highest launch month sales for any Paradox Interactive title.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-55) In March 2022, Paradox Interactive announced that _Crusader Kings III_ had sold over 2 million units worldwide.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-56) In September 2023, Paradox Interactive announced that _Crusader Kings III_ had sold over 3 million units worldwide.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-:2-57) As of April 2025, _Crusader Kings III_ has sold over 4 million copies worldwide.[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_III#cite_note-58)
